package jira

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"math"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/eshu-hq/eshu/go/internal/scope"
	"github.com/eshu-hq/eshu/go/internal/workflow"
)

// zzReplayScenario is one recorded Jira site: the activation config, the
// credential environment, a fixed clock, and the HTTP responses keyed by
// "METHOD path?sortedQuery" (POST search adds "#<nextPageToken>"). The same
// files drive the in-tree collector when the parity goldens are regenerated
// (see testdata/README.md), so this harness keeps no collector-specific logic.
type zzReplayScenario struct {
	Name      string                    `json:"name"`
	Now       time.Time                 `json:"now"`
	Env       map[string]string         `json:"env"`
	Config    map[string]any            `json:"config"`
	Responses map[string]zzReplayResult `json:"responses"`
}

type zzReplayResult struct {
	Status  int               `json:"status"`
	Headers map[string]string `json:"headers"`
	Body    json.RawMessage   `json:"body"`
}

// zzReplayTransport serves a scenario without opening a socket and records what
// the collector asked for.
type zzReplayTransport struct {
	scenario zzReplayScenario
	mu       sync.Mutex
	calls    []string
	missing  []string
	auth     []string
	bodies   []string
}

func zzLoadScenario(t testing.TB, name string) zzReplayScenario {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("testdata", "source", name+".json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read scenario %s: %v", name, err)
	}
	var scenario zzReplayScenario
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &scenario); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode scenario %s: %v", name, err)
	}
	return scenario
}

func (s zzReplayScenario) getenv(key string) string { return s.Env[key] }

func zzNewReplayTransport(scenario zzReplayScenario) *zzReplayTransport {
	return &zzReplayTransport{scenario: scenario}
}

func (r *zzReplayTransport) client() *http.Client {
	return &http.Client{Transport: r}
}

// RoundTrip implements http.RoundTripper.
func (r *zzReplayTransport) RoundTrip(request *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	// A real transport stops on a canceled or expired context; so does this.
	if err := request.Context().Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var body []byte
	if request.Body != nil {
		body, _ = io.ReadAll(request.Body)
		_ = request.Body.Close()
	}
	key := zzReplayKey(request.Method, request.URL, body)
	r.mu.Lock()
	r.calls = append(r.calls, key)
	r.auth = append(r.auth, request.Header.Get("Authorization"))
	r.bodies = append(r.bodies, string(body))
	entry, ok := r.scenario.Responses[key]
	if !ok {
		r.missing = append(r.missing, key)
	}
	r.mu.Unlock()
	if !ok {
		entry = zzReplayResult{Status: http.StatusNotFound, Body: json.RawMessage(`{"errorMessages":["no replay entry"]}`)}
	}
	header := http.Header{"Content-Type": []string{"application/json"}}
	for name, value := range entry.Headers {
		header.Set(name, value)
	}
	return &http.Response{
		Status:     fmt.Sprintf("%d %s", entry.Status, http.StatusText(entry.Status)),
		StatusCode: entry.Status,
		Header:     header,
		Body:       io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(entry.Body)),
		Request:    request,
	}, nil
}

func zzReplayKey(method string, u *url.URL, body []byte) string {
	key := method + " " + u.Path
	if query := u.Query(); len(query) > 0 {
		key += "?" + query.Encode()
	}
	if method == http.MethodPost {
		var decoded struct {
			NextPageToken string `json:"nextPageToken"`
		}
		_ = json.Unmarshal(body, &decoded)
		key += "#" + decoded.NextPageToken
	}
	return key
}

func (r *zzReplayTransport) sortedCalls() []string {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	out := append([]string(nil), r.calls...)
	sort.Strings(out)
	return out
}

func (r *zzReplayTransport) missingKeys() []string {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]string(nil), r.missing...)
}

type zzFactDump struct {
	Kind             string         `json:"kind"`
	StableKey        string         `json:"stable_key"`
	SchemaVersion    string         `json:"schema_version"`
	SourceConfidence string         `json:"source_confidence"`
	CollectorKind    string         `json:"collector_kind"`
	ObservedAt       string         `json:"observed_at"`
	SourceSystem     string         `json:"source_system"`
	SourceScopeID    string         `json:"source_scope_id"`
	SourceURI        string         `json:"source_uri"`
	SourceRecordID   string         `json:"source_record_id"`
	IsTombstone      bool           `json:"is_tombstone"`
	Payload          map[string]any `json:"payload"`
}

type zzGolden struct {
	Scenario string `json:"scenario"`
	Outcome  string `json:"outcome"`
	Scope    struct {
		ScopeID       string `json:"scope_id"`
		ScopeKind     string `json:"scope_kind"`
		SourceSystem  string `json:"source_system"`
		CollectorKind string `json:"collector_kind"`
		PartitionKey  string `json:"partition_key"`
	} `json:"scope"`
	Generation struct {
		GenerationID    string `json:"generation_id"`
		ObservedAt      string `json:"observed_at"`
		FreshnessHint   string `json:"freshness_hint"`
		TrustedDeletion bool   `json:"trusted_deletion"`
	} `json:"generation"`
	Facts   []zzFactDump `json:"facts,omitempty"`
	Failure *struct {
		Class          string `json:"class"`
		Terminal       bool   `json:"terminal"`
		Operation      string `json:"operation"`
		RetryAfterSecs int    `json:"retry_after_seconds"`
	} `json:"failure,omitempty"`
}

func zzTarget(t *testing.T, s zzReplayScenario) TargetConfig {
	t.Helper()
	str := func(k string) string { v, _ := s.Config[k].(string); return v }
	num := func(k string) int { v, _ := s.Config[k].(float64); return int(v) }
	lookback, err := time.ParseDuration(str("updated_lookback"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return TargetConfig{
		ScopeID: "jira:site:fixture", SiteID: str("site_id"), BaseURL: str("base_url"),
		Email: s.Env[str("email_env")], Token: s.Env[str("token_env")], JQL: str("jql"),
		IssueLimit: num("issue_limit"), UpdatedLookback: lookback, ChangelogLimit: num("changelog_limit"),
		RemoteLinkLimit: num("remote_link_limit"), MetadataLimit: num("metadata_limit"),
	}
}

// TestZZGoldenParity regenerates the parity goldens from the in-tree
// collector. Throwaway: it lives only in the golden worktree.
func TestZZGoldenParity(t *testing.T) {
	srcDir := os.Getenv("GOLDEN_SCENARIOS")
	outDir := os.Getenv("GOLDEN_OUT_DIR")
	if srcDir == "" || outDir == "" {
		t.Skip("GOLDEN_SCENARIOS / GOLDEN_OUT_DIR not set")
	}
	files, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(srcDir, "*.json"))
	if err != nil || len(files) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("no scenarios in %s", srcDir)
	}
	for _, file := range files {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(file)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var s zzReplayScenario
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		transport := zzNewReplayTransport(s)
		target := zzTarget(t, s)
		source, err := NewClaimedSource(SourceConfig{
			CollectorInstanceID: "jira-qa",
			Targets:             []TargetConfig{target},
			ClientFactory: func(tc TargetConfig) (EvidenceClient, error) {
				return NewHTTPClient(HTTPClientConfig{BaseURL: tc.BaseURL, Email: tc.Email, Token: tc.Token, Client: transport.client()})
			},
			Now: func() time.Time { return s.Now },
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: NewClaimedSource: %v", s.Name, err)
		}
		item := workflow.WorkItem{
			WorkItemID: "work-1", RunID: "run-1", SourceRunID: "run-1", CollectorKind: scope.CollectorJira, CollectorInstanceID: "jira-qa",
			SourceSystem: "jira", ScopeID: "jira:site:fixture", GenerationID: "generation-1", Status: workflow.WorkItemStatusClaimed,
			AttemptCount: 1, CurrentFencingToken: 7, LeaseExpiresAt: s.Now.Add(time.Hour),
		}
		g := zzGolden{Scenario: s.Name}
		generation, ok, err := source.NextClaimed(context.Background(), item)
		if err != nil {
			g.Outcome = "failure"
			var pf ProviderFailure
			if !errors.As(err, &pf) {
				t.Fatalf("%s: non-provider failure %T: %v", s.Name, err, err)
			}
			g.Failure = &struct {
				Class          string `json:"class"`
				Terminal       bool   `json:"terminal"`
				Operation      string `json:"operation"`
				RetryAfterSecs int    `json:"retry_after_seconds"`
			}{pf.FailureClass(), pf.TerminalFailure(), pf.FailureOperation(), int(math.Ceil(pf.RetryAfterDelay().Seconds()))}
		} else {
			if !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s: not ok", s.Name)
			}
			g.Outcome = "generation"
			g.Scope.ScopeID = generation.Scope.ScopeID
			g.Scope.ScopeKind = string(generation.Scope.ScopeKind)
			g.Scope.SourceSystem = generation.Scope.SourceSystem
			g.Scope.CollectorKind = string(generation.Scope.CollectorKind)
			g.Scope.PartitionKey = generation.Scope.PartitionKey
			g.Generation.GenerationID = generation.Generation.GenerationID
			g.Generation.ObservedAt = generation.Generation.ObservedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano)
			g.Generation.FreshnessHint = generation.Generation.FreshnessHint
			g.Generation.TrustedDeletion = generation.Generation.TrustedDeletion
			for env := range generation.Facts {
				// Round-trip the payload through JSON so the dump holds exactly
				// what a JSON consumer reads.
				encoded, err := json.Marshal(env.Payload)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				var payload map[string]any
				if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &payload); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				g.Facts = append(g.Facts, zzFactDump{
					Kind: env.FactKind, StableKey: env.StableFactKey, SchemaVersion: env.SchemaVersion, SourceConfidence: env.SourceConfidence,
					CollectorKind: env.CollectorKind, ObservedAt: env.ObservedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
					SourceSystem: env.SourceRef.SourceSystem, SourceScopeID: env.SourceRef.ScopeID, SourceURI: env.SourceRef.SourceURI,
					SourceRecordID: env.SourceRef.SourceRecordID, IsTombstone: env.IsTombstone, Payload: payload,
				})
			}
		}
		if missing := transport.missingKeys(); len(missing) > 0 && g.Outcome == "generation" {
			t.Fatalf("%s: scenario lacks replay entries: %v", s.Name, missing)
		}
		out, err := json.MarshalIndent(g, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(outDir, s.Name+".golden.json"), append(out, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		t.Logf("%s: %s facts=%d", s.Name, g.Outcome, len(g.Facts))
	}
}
